subject: Renewal + expansion pricing follow-up: volume step-ups & blended rates (NovaHealth)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@novahealth.com>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@novahealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood + NovaHealth — renewal & expansion pricing

Alex / Jordan — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our call so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Objectives
- Renew existing Redwood contract for production inference (current baseline: ~3B tokens/month across two routes).
- Add two new routes for multi-model workflows (LLM-chat + reranking) and evaluate blended pricing.
- Target: reduce unit cost as volume grows while maintaining performance SLAs.

2) Customer-provided signals
- Current monthly token consumption (approx): 3B tokens/month, with peak bursts to 4.5B.
- Expected growth: 30-50% over next 12 months as new routes onboard.
- Budget guidance (high level): ballpark $35k–$60k/month for inference (open to options for committed pricing).

3) Redwood pricing topics we discussed
- Volume step-up tiers (illustrative) and blended-rate approach for combining model routes.
- Target $/1M tokens goals for NovaHealth depending on model mix and commit.
- Need historical usage by route + model family to produce an accurate blended quote.

4) Actions / next steps
- Alex: share last 6 months of token usage by route/model if possible (CSV) — helps compute blended rate. (Alex to send by 9/17)
- Marissa: share a draft pricing proposal with step-up tiers and blended-rate examples (attached).
- Internal: Marissa will confirm discount approvals with finance (looping Rishi).
- Follow-up: schedule a 30-min pricing walkthrough next week — propose 9/22 or 9/23.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_proposal_q3.xlsx (draft illustrative tiers / blended examples)

If I missed anything from the call, please flag. Otherwise I’ll incorporate your usage CSV into the attached workbook and follow up with a blended quote by EOD 9/18.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference runtime.

From: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T17:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood + NovaHealth — renewal & expansion pricing

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Usage CSV: attaching a quick export of the last 6 months by route (chat / rerank / embeddings). The exported columns are month, route, model_family, tokens. (I’ll send the full CSV shortly; this is a preview via link.)
- Budget: the $35k–$60k/month range is for production inference only; team is evaluating whether a committed discount vs. on-demand makes sense.
- Target $/1M tokens: internally we were hoping to see something in the low hundreds for the blended rate at scale (e.g., $200–$600/1M depending on model mix). We recognize model mix matters a lot.

Question: when you say blended-rate examples, is that net of any GPU or region surcharges? Also curious how you treat models that require dedicated capacity vs hosted.

I’ll send the full CSV by tomorrow (9/16) EOD.

—Alex
Alex Dunne
Director of ML Engineering | NovaHealth
alex.dunne@novahealth.com | (212) 555-3333

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@novahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Smith <j.smith@novahealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood + NovaHealth — renewal & expansion pricing

Thanks Alex — got the preview and appreciate the guidance on target bands. A few concrete numbers to frame the conversation (these are illustrative — final blended quote will reflect the CSV and model route split):

Illustrative step-up tiers (tokens/month across account):
- 0 – 5B: $1,000 / 1M tokens
- 5B – 20B: $800 / 1M tokens
- >20B: $600 / 1M tokens

Blended-rate example (mix case):
- If NovaHealth stays at ~3B/month with the new routes (chat heavy): blended ~$900 / 1M tokens.
- If growth hits 12B/month with a mix (chat 50%, rerank 30%, embeddings 20%) and you commit to 12 months, blended ~$700 / 1M tokens.
- At >20B/month with a higher percentage on rerank/embeddings (cheaper model families), blended ~ $550–$650 / 1M tokens.

Notes on what’s included
- These examples assume hosted inference and exclude major region surcharges. Dedicated capacity or isolated/private deployments have a different component (capacity reservation) we can model separately.
- Blended rates account for model family tiers (chat models priced higher than embeddings) — we compute a weighted average based on token share per route/model.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_proposal_q3.xlsx (I updated the workbook with the example tiers and a blended calculator tab — see the "Blended_sample" sheet).

Next steps
- Alex: please send the full CSV by EOD so I can populate the blended calculator (you mentioned you’ll send today).
- Once I have usage detail I’ll produce 2 concrete options: 
  a) 12-month commit with volume step-ups and target blended rate;
  b) 24-month commit with higher step-ups and an additional operational credit for onboarding (SLA/rollout support).
- I’ll also draft an SOW/LOI to align on routes and expected onboarding milestones; Rishi, can you confirm rough approval for up to a 15% blended discount on the 12-month commit so we can include that in the LOI?

Available to walk through the workbook — propose 9/22 at 11am PT for a 30-min pricing walkthrough.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_pricing_proposal_q3.xlsx (updated)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: Redwood + NovaHealth — renewal & expansion pricing (internal)

Marissa / Steph — gave this a quick pass. High level: finance is willing to approve up to a 15% blended discount for a 12-month commit if the blended rate stays above our floors across the modeled scenarios. For >20B tiers, we need to route to VP approval for anything beyond 18% discount.

Please include SOW_draft.pdf with the LOI and call out the onboarding milestone payments (30% on sign, 40% on initial production rollout, 30% on completion). Also ensure the blended calculator in the workbook shows the pre-discount and post-discount columns.

I can join the 9/22 call if needed.

-Rishi
